Valuation Lab · 简体中文

MRVL · 2026-08-01

Marvell dated operating EV: downside $30.44bn, base $100.41bn, management-delivery $211.79bn. These are execution scenarios without assigned probabilities; current common equity and per-share values remain unavailable.

Financial origin August 1, 2026; information through October 18; capital inventory August 18. Retrospective-information operating research, not an August backtest or October price target. H2 FY2027 is fixed; the editable 15-year tail runs FY2028–FY2042.

Data-center expansion, custom silicon, optical connectivity and customer concentration drive scenario differences. Sixteen contiguous quarters, Q3 FY2023–Q2 FY2027: revenue exceeded original midpoint 15/16, stayed within range 16/16, mean beat 1.10%, median 0.96%. This does not establish a probability for the uncompleted $20bn FY2028 or $70–90bn FY2031 management outlook.

Editable margins expense R&D and recurring future equity grants economically. Legacy awards remain a separate unresolved claim. R&D capitalization is reconciled without a cash-flow uplift: economic NOPAT and investment both add the same net research investment. Historical GAAP SBC is not a universal future grant-cost estimate.

Every edit and simulation trial recomputes nonresearch investment, supplier deposits, working capital and operating cash; entered investment is retained and topped up if needed. No contraction-driven cash release is invented. Terminal investment includes capitalized research and is checked against the cash funding floor. August covenant compliance is verified; future headroom, supplier timing, withholding, forward settlement and refinancing remain unknown. Revolver expiry is June 2030. Cash deficits are already in FCFF and are not deducted from EV again.

Opening operating cash reserve is $1bn. Supplier prepayments and working-capital commitments are operating investment, not verified credit capacity. The 4.00x gross contractual debt / contractual EBITDA covenant cannot be tested using economic DCF EBIT or cash-netted debt.

Source period WACC fades to 9%; the fixed H2 stub uses a half-year exponent. Annual tail edits and simulations do not alter the selected stub. Terminal ROIC is a separate assumption, initially equal to 9% WACC.

Cash operating taxes apply to expensed-R&D EBIT. Capitalizing R&D does not create an immediate tax deduction or tax gross-up on research investment.

Continuing-year economic NOPAT includes net five-year research investment; total reinvestment equals economic NOPAT × growth / ROIC. The equivalent nonresearch investment subtracts net R&D once. No free terminal growth.

NVIDIA $2bn proceeds are already in August cash; 21.78m common equivalents join 876.93m August common shares, with no second preferred deduction. Employee awards, Google warrants and Celestial earnout require joint allocation. Choose earnout fair value OR earned shares plus cash; never both.

Google base vesting/exercise arithmetic is not the complete contract or a long-dated option valuation. Cap 58.97m, strike $206.58; first time vest November 18, performance vesting unestablished. Hypothetical exercise proceeds are not current funding. The $131m forward asset is excluded from NWC; $300m notional is neither excess cash nor a share reduction. Unknown forward exposure is not zero or capped at notional. Common equity stays gated.

All new simulation widths are zero; Run is manual. Nonzero uncertainty is an uncalibrated user assumption. Zero-width runs reproduce each selected operating EV; common-equity allocation remains unavailable for every trial.

Ten fiscal years FY2017–FY2026 retain raw units, filing provenance and legal-predecessor links. Acquisitions, divestitures, fiscal weeks and acquired-intangible amortization limit comparability. Reported SBC, ordinary D&A and acquired-intangible amortization remain separate; this is not an organic owner-earnings history.

MRVL · 2026-08-01

Marvell 历史基准日经营企业价值：下行 304.41 亿美元、基准 1,004.09 亿美元、管理层兑现情景 2,117.90 亿美元。各情景无指定概率；当前普通股权益及每股价值仍不可用。

财务基准日为 2026 年 8 月 1 日，信息截至 10 月 18 日，资本盘点日为 8 月 18 日。这是回溯信息经营研究。2027 财年下半年固定，2028–2042 财年为可编辑的十五年预测。并非八月回测或十月目标价。

数据中心、定制芯片、光互连及客户集中度决定情景差异。2023 财年第三季至 2027 财年第二季连续十六季中，收入十五季超过原始中点、十六季位于区间内，平均超过 1.10%、中位数 0.96%。这不能转化为尚未实现的 2028 财年 200 亿及 2031 财年 700–900 亿美元管理层目标的兑现概率。

可编辑利润率已费用化研发及未来经常性股权授予。旧奖励仍是单独待定请求权。研发资本化在经济税后营业利润及投资中等额增加净研发投资，不增加现金流。历史会计股权薪酬不是未来授予成本的通用估计。

每次编辑及模拟均重算非研发投资、供应商保证金、营运资本和经营现金；保留输入投资，必要时补足。不凭收入下降推定现金释放。终值投资包含资本化研发，并须覆盖现金资金下限。八月契约合规已核实；未来额度、供应商时点、代扣、远期结算及再融资未知。循环额度于 2030 年 6 月到期。现金缺口已在现金流中，不再次从企业价值扣除。

期初经营现金储备为 10 亿美元。供应商预付款和营运资本承诺属于经营投资，并非已核实信贷额度。4.00 倍契约总债务／契约 EBITDA 测试不能使用经济营业利润或扣现金后的债务。

来源期间资本成本逐步降至 9%；固定下半年使用半年度折现指数。年度编辑及模拟不改变选定短期期间。终值投入资本回报率是独立假设，初始等于 9% 资本成本。

经营现金税基于研发费用化后的营业利润。研发资本化不产生即期税收扣除，也不对研发投资进行税额放大。

持续经营年度经济税后营业利润包括五年研发净投资；总再投资为经济税后营业利润乘增长率除以投入资本回报率。对应非研发投资仅减去一次净研发投资，终值增长并非免费。

NVIDIA 的 20 亿美元所得已在八月现金中；2,177.80 万普通股等价单位加入八月 87,692.66 万普通股，不重复扣优先股。员工奖励、Google 认股权证及 Celestial 或有对价须联立分配。或有对价应选择公允价值或已赚取股份加现金，不可同时计入。

Google 基础归属及行权算式不代表完整合同或长期期权估值。上限 5,897.09 万份，行权价 206.58 美元；首次时间归属于 11 月 18 日，绩效归属未确定。假设行权所得不是当前资金。1.31 亿美元远期资产已从营运资本剔除；3 亿美元名义本金不是超额现金或减股数，未知风险不能设为零或以名义本金封顶。普通股估值继续受限。

新增模拟宽度均为零，须手动运行。非零不确定性是未校准的用户假设。零宽度模拟复现选定经营企业价值；所有试验的普通股分配均不可用。

2017–2026 十个财年保留原始单位、申报依据及法律前身链接。收购、出售、财年周数及收购无形资产摊销限制可比性。已报告股权薪酬、普通折旧摊销和收购无形资产摊销分列；不是有机增长或所有者收益历史。
